description: This file handles updating relations between purchase order entities and other modules within the vtiger CRM system. It processes incoming request parameters, determines the context, and calls functions to relate specified entities, then redirects the user accordingly.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents an entity in vtiger CRM, with methods to instantiate entity objects.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent injections or malicious data.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the current parent tab context in the CRM UI.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to get an instance of a CRM entity based on module name.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Links multiple entities to a parent CRM record.
